finding: The dominant stall is outside traced ProcessFrame/CoreManagerRender work, not a 242-second game update. Both Preview frame delivery and the scheduled editor capture timer were delayed.
hypothesis: Editor/Preview scheduling or synchronous/reentrant native messaging; exact blocking native call is not identified.
pluginAudit: Installed LEAF uses asynchronous Promises and setTimeout, no busy-loop wait. It synchronously posts ScenarioCompletedRequest inside the ScenarioStartResponse callback; Lens replies synchronously through Editor.context.postMessage. This is a candidate native re-entrancy boundary, not a proven cause.
limits: Only three paired startup frames; do not use this sample as representative gameplay FPS.
Startup audio also causes real multi-second Scene::Start/Update spans.
No installed plugin, cache or OS service was changed.
